info.title: MICROSERVICE-apiwizruntimedoc-List Pharmacy Prescriptions Deliverys-v2-spec
info.description: The Pharmacy Prescriptions Delivery API provides access to comprehensive data regarding delivery details for prescriptions. This API allows users to retrieve information about the status, timing, and logistics involved in prescription deliveries at pharmacies. It is designed for pharmacists, healthcare providers, and logistics professionals who need to track and manage prescription deliveries efficiently. Through this endpoint, applications can integrate delivery management functionalities, enhancing the overall patient experience by ensuring timely access to medications.

get.description: This endpoint allows users to fetch details about prescription deliveries, including status and expected delivery times. It is designed to help patients stay updated on their prescribed medications.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve delivery information for prescriptions. It should contain necessary parameters to filter the delivery details according to user preferences.

ListPharmacyPrescriptionsDeliverysReques.description: A JSON formatted string representing the request body for the GET operation related to prescriptions delivery.

ListPharmacyPrescriptionsDeliverysRespon.title: Prescription Delivery Response

status.description: Indicates whether the operation was successful.

referenceNumber.description: The reference number associated with the prescription delivery.

resultId.description: The unique identifier for the result of the operation.

state.description: The current state of the prescription delivery.

processingTimeMs.description: The time taken to process the delivery request, in milliseconds.

message.description: A message providing additional information about the response.

ListPharmacyPrescriptionsDeliverysRespon.description: This schema represents the response from the Prescription Delivery operation.

AuditInfo.title: Audit Information

createdBy.description: The user who created the prescription delivery entry.

createdAt.description: The timestamp when the prescription delivery entry was created.

automated.description: Indicates whether the operation was automated.

AuditInfo.description: This schema provides details about the audit information related to the prescription delivery.

x-processing-time.description: The time, in milliseconds, that the server took to process the request. This value can help in understanding performance and latency.
